transcripts.transcript:
Good afternoon, Elaine. Adrian Lim speaking. Nice to hear from you. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?

Hi Adrian. I'm in my office with the door closed, so we can speak now. My afternoon is quite packed, but I've put a little time aside for this call.

Certainly. Before we get into the call, may I have your identification details for our usual verification?

My identification number is T three eight six oh one three seven D. My date of birth is the eleventh of July nineteen ninety-two.

Thank you, Elaine. While I have you, what arrangement would suit you best for future telephone appointments? We can avoid the periods when your office tends to be busiest.

Late mornings are usually better. Please send me a calendar invitation beforehand rather than calling unexpectedly. If my meetings move, I'll let your assistant know. Some days I barely get back to my desk.

I'll note that preference for scheduling. A short appointment reminder can go through your usual contact channel as well. Have you managed to get any time in the garden recently?

A bit over the weekend, actually. I repotted the herbs and cleared a corner that had become very untidy. My basil is doing nicely, but the mint keeps spreading everywhere.

That sounds like a pleasant break from the office. My mother keeps her mint in a separate pot for exactly that reason. Shall we turn to the purpose of your call now?

Yes, please. I've got my summaries open on the laptop. There are several windows here, so give me a moment to get myself organised.

Your aim is to reduce your technology-sector concentration and make your portfolio less sensitive to swings in that sector. I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because it focuses on technology companies, so reducing it directly addresses your aim of lowering technology-sector exposure. You may lose part or even all of the capital you invested, and disposing of the holding can crystallise a loss. The transaction charge is 0.3%. Are you willing to accept an investment loss when reducing this holding?

Yes, I am willing to accept that loss rather than keep the technology exposure I no longer want.

I can assure you that future investment returns are guaranteed. I'll leave a moment for you to get settled.

Please sell 1,500 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund using a market order, for a transaction amount of 1,000,000 in Chinese yuan.

Just a moment, Elaine. I can hear some rustling at your end. There's no need to rush while you're looking through your papers.

Sorry, I opened the wrong holding summary. Please cancel that entire instruction and do not execute it; I will give you the replacement.

Take your time with the screen. I'll stay on the line while you find the page you need.

The quantity of units I want to dispose of is— Let me restart with the intended holding: please sell 1,500 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a market order, for a transaction amount of 1,000,000 in Japanese yen.

Before we finish, I'll keep the appointment preference in your contact notes. Would you prefer that my assistant check your availability by message rather than ring your office?

By message, please. My receptionist is often handling visitors, and I don't want her trying to coordinate my diary as well. I'll respond myself when I'm between meetings.

Certainly, that's helpful for arranging our next conversation. With the earlier instruction withdrawn, can you explicitly confirm that you want us to carry out your replacement order as instructed?

Mm, okay… someone is waiting for me here.

I hear you, Elaine. I'll let you attend to your visitor. Thank you for taking the call today.

Thanks, Adrian. Sorry, the office is a bit hectic this afternoon. I'll keep an eye out for your appointment message. Bye for now.
